mode: synthetic renderer contract checks; no real APK downloads or USB installation
checks: current version queues only package metadata and exposes a separate download center
history pages require server version codes and pass the selected page back for verification
main process events update progress, speed and unknown-length streams without inventing completion
pause preserves progress and explicit continue uses only the native task capability
pending pause cleanup locks continuation and restart while explaining unavailable validators
cancel and retry are explicit bounded task actions and reset the queue progress
open, reveal and USB selection become available only after verified completion
download failures retain explicit errors and list refresh failures keep completed history visible
account changes release old subscriptions and history read errors do not appear as empty success
a disposed account subscription cannot replace the current download history with a late event
